title: Sync from live keeps live tag changes, a live-only menu reorder and a kept article's dependent rows; names what it did not take; never carries edit locks or snapshot tables; reports its step while running; Sync anyway reuses the held run; WordPress sites sync too
expect: S1: tag map rows merge by their natural key; a live-only reorder reaches the copy and a both-sides reorder is kept and named; a kept article keeps its workflow, tag and field rows; checked_out stays the copy's; _tracy_snap_* tables are never compared; Sync anyway after a hold reuses the read when live did not move; a WordPress live site syncs with its address rewritten, wp-config merged per constant and both sides' new posts renumbered

selectors.host: live_sync.py row_key naturalKeys orderedTrees dependents sessionColumns counterColumns TRACY_COPY_TABLE; live_sync_wordpress.py prepare merge_wp_config; webroot-sync.sh keep_held resume_held

fence: A change the live site made never disappears without a name, a Tracy change is never overwritten, and a WordPress site syncs like a Joomla one
